New issue 84 by DaveRBl...@gmail.com: operators "<=" and "<" appear to be
switched during compilation into C++
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=84

What version of RStan are you using? (type: "stan_version()" in R)
Stan 1.1.0

What operating system are you on? What version of R? What compiler are you
using?

Mac OSX 10.6.8
Not using R
g++ version 4.2.1

What steps will reproduce the problem? (please attach a simple model and
data if appropriate)

Stan Code:
"""
while (k < maxSummation-1){
...
}

"""

Compiled C++ Code:
"""
while (as_bool(logical_lte(k,(maxSummation - 1)))){
...
}
"""

What is the expected output? What do you see instead?

I believe the correct compilation is:

Compiled C++ Code:
"""
while (as_bool(logical_lt(k,(maxSummation - 1)))){
...
}
"""

Furthermore, I think the bug is in the file "expression_grammar_def.hpp,"
lines 219 and 223, although I am not terribly familiar the source code.


Please provide any additional information below.

Great software! Very impressed!
